display.purpose: Title block of a details modal over its backdrop.

title.purpose: Card titles, list rows and the search input.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked metadata and section eyebrows; text-label is 0.6875rem / 1rem (11px / 16px), the minimum text size. Use stone-400 or lighter on dark surfaces and 14px or larger for decision-critical copy.

shadows.name: lamp-glow
shadows.purpose: Warm lift under the primary button.

shadows.name: modal-depth
shadows.purpose: Details modals, the dock and the space switcher.

shadows.name: title-scrim
shadows.purpose: Serif titles set directly over backdrop art.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Opacity and transform motion at 200ms to 300ms; progress uses 500ms. Reduced motion minimizes transitions. Never animate layout properties or fills.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Active press feedback on buttons and dock items.

collections.worldTiles: Worlds grid under the hero: text-only, identical type, per-World deep muted textured fill from config. Separate finite non-looping Collections rail of saga posters above The Classics, ending with a neutral All collections tile
collections.worldPage: Edge-to-edge 16:9 art behind the status bar fading to Shell Black, title only, then finite scroll-snap poster shelves per saga (no search, sort, chips or visible counts)
collections.eligibility: Editorial catalog defaults only; no household override UI
collections.ordering: Frozen during a visit; meaningful activity or A–Z
collections.progress: Separate household feature, provider, short and TV counts

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Button variant="primary" (default): the main action on a surface. Native button props and className customize context sizing.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Button variant="secondary": supporting actions, stone-800 fill, stone-200 text and stone-700 border.

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Serif text field with a warm amber focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Search for a title">

components.name: Energy Chip
components.description: Static light, balanced or focused indicator; always labeled. ENERGY_STYLES in src/config/energyStyles.js supplies badge, icon and selected colors. getEnergyStyle falls back to balanced; unknown poster energy shows no band or badge.

components.name: Dock Item (current)
components.description: Floating Add / Tonight / Library dock over scrolling artwork. Current Tonight item uses aria-current="page" and an amber wash; targets are at least 44px and the fixed dock includes --safe-bottom.

components.name: Poster Card
components.description: Poster with a 4px top energy band and labeled energy state. Shows in progress use shared ProgressBar at the base; watched state also has an icon.

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Button variant="danger": destructive actions, red-900/20 fill, red-400 text and red-900/30 border; hover uses red-900/40. All Button variants use a 12px radius, press scale with reduced-motion reset, and 50% disabled opacity.

components.name: Glass Button
components.description: Button variant="glass" exists for artwork overlays only: stone-900/60 fill, backdrop-blur-md, stone-800 border and stone-200 text; hover uses stone-800. Never use blur on a plain background or modal scrim.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Use Dialog for modal roots, or useDialog on an existing root. Mount only while open and name it with aria-labelledby. Both provide role="dialog", aria-modal, initial focus, a focus trap, topmost-only Escape and Tab handling, and focus return to the opener. useDialog accepts initialFocusRef. A scrim is a decorative sibling to the panel, aria-hidden and outside the tab order; preserve a named close control. Use flat bg-stone-950/85 without blur because the current var(--shell-bg) Tailwind color does not support bg-shell/NN opacity modifiers.
components.html: Title details

components.name: IconButton
components.description: Use for icon-only close, back and dismiss controls. label is required and becomes aria-label. plain is for plain surfaces; overlay uses a stone-950/90 fill and stone-700 border over artwork. Both have a 44px minimum target, amber focus ring and reduced-motion-aware press feedback.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.description: Use shared ProgressBar for TV, collection and import progress. value is clamped to 0-100; min keeps a sliver for started items. heightClassName defaults to h-1.5 (6px); square removes pill rounding. The full-width fill uses transform scaleX with a 500ms motion-safe transition. label exposes progressbar role and values; omit label when an adjacent text count makes the bar decorative.

components.name: SelectChip
components.description: Use for short sets such as vibe, energy and type. selected is exposed with aria-pressed, an underlined selected label and an amber wash, never color alone. Supply visible text or an icon with text. selectedClassName supports energy-specific styles from ENERGY_STYLES. The control uses 12px text and a 44px minimum target.

components.name: CollectionCardLandscape
components.description: Landscape collection artwork reserves a top-aligned h-12 sm:h-14 title or logo zone and an h-8 metadata zone. Text titles clamp to two lines; logos retain proportions. Count and year begin consistently, with whitespace-nowrap tabular-nums years and spacing instead of a separator dot. Started collections use a 2px top ProgressBar with min={4} and square; complete collections also show a text badge.

narrative.overview: Hearth is a dark, warm room with one source of light. The shell is a near-black with a trace of brown, and everything else is lit from within: poster and backdrop artwork supplies the drama, and a single amber accent plays the role of the lamp. The interface chrome stays low and quiet so two people on a couch can look at titles, not at controls.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black warm shell; amber as the only brand accent.
Serif titles over a system sans body; uppercase tracked labels with an 11px floor.
Soft, large radii (12px controls, 16px to 24px containers, full pills for chips).
Artwork-first: posters and backdrops are the saturated element, chrome recedes.
Tonal depth first, shadow second; blur only where text must sit on artwork.
Dim-room comfort: no pure black, no pure white, no glare.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only brand hue. On any screen it marks the primary action and the current state, nothing else.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every grey is a stone (warm-tinted). Pure #000 and #fff are forbidden.

rules.name: The Energy Code Rule
rules.body: Sky, amber and red appear together only as the light / balanced / focused energy indicator, always with a text label.

rules.name: The World Tint Rule
rules.body: Each World has one muted OKLCH tint (chroma under 0.1) defined in collectionWorlds.js. Decorative only: a deep muted tile fill with a CSS-only blurred light-spot and faint grain (one recipe for all tiles), plus a short rule or ring on the World page; never amber, never in danger/energy hues, never a side stripe or saturated block, never sole carrier of meaning, always beside the World's name; Bone text stays above 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Serif Names Things Rule
rules.body: Serif is for things with names. Sans is for things that describe or act.

rules.name: The Small Caps Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Eyebrows and metadata use text-label at 0.6875rem / 1rem (11px / 16px) or larger, stone-400 or lighter on dark surfaces, bold uppercase tracking, and never carry primary information. Decision-critical text is 14px or larger.

rules.name: The Dim Room Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; lift and glow answer state or float above artwork.

rules.name: The Functional Blur Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur is a legibility device over imagery only. Plain backgrounds stay flat. Modal scrims use flat bg-stone-950/85 without blur; bg-shell/NN opacity is unsupported by the current CSS-variable color definition.

rules.name: The Product Register Rule
rules.body: Keep a calm, literal interface for two people sharing a shelf, with one clear page heading, visible focus and clear selected, disabled, empty, loading and error states. Preserve current workflows during visual cleanup: no new decision CTA, Tonight rail cap, duplicate-detection or undo behavior, show-modal primary-action changes, or plain-title Import redesign. Automatic hero advance stops after interaction and is disabled for reduced motion.

dos: Do let poster and backdrop artwork be the saturated element; keep chrome in stone neutrals.
Do use Ember Amber (#d97706) for exactly one primary action per surface, with Soot (#1c1917) text.
Do tint every neutral warm (the stone ramp); end at Bone (#f5f5f4) and Shell Black (#0c0a09).
Do pair every color-coded state (energy, watched, in progress) with a label or icon.
Do paint the shell Shell Black behind notches and overscroll, and add --safe-* insets to fixed bars.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on any new animation, and animate transform and opacity only.
Do use shared Dialog/useDialog, IconButton, ProgressBar and SelectChip primitives for consistent behavior and accessible states.
Do keep text at least 11px and stone-400 or lighter on dark surfaces, decision-critical copy at least 14px, and interactive targets at least 44px.
Do give fields persistent labels and explain errors near the affected field without relying on color alone.
donts: Don't build a gamified or social app: no streaks, badges, feeds, leaderboards or notification nags.
Don't drift into a generic dark SaaS dashboard: no cold blue-grey panels, glass cards, gradient accents, gradient fills or gradient text.
Don't show algorithmic recommender patterns: no match percentages, no "because you watched", no ranked or explained suggestions.
Don't use blur or translucency on plain backgrounds; it is only for legibility over artwork.
Don't use #000 or #fff, or introduce a second brand hue beside amber.
Don't add border-left or border-right wider than 1px as a colored accent.
Don't create endless rows, autoplay or infinite scroll; the shelf is finite on purpose.
Don't nest cards inside cards or add a container where spacing would do.
Don't use em dashes in interface copy.
Don't use gradients outside neutral scrims over artwork; plain backgrounds stay flat.
